name: tseller.co.za
description:
TSeller connects your Takealot seller account to your assistant, so you can ask about your store in plain language instead of exporting reports.

It reads sales and revenue over any date range, orders, listings, prices, stock on hand, lead times, success and fulfilment fees, transactions and payouts, realised profit per listing, returns with reasons and outcomes, inbound shipments to Takealot's distribution centres, replenishment plans and your Stock Availability score, live Buy Box position with competitors, and customer reviews from takealot.com.

It can also change listings: selling price, recommended retail price, stock on hand, lead time, and whether a listing is enabled — one at a time or in bulk. Every change is confirmed with you first, applied to Takealot under your own seller account, then read back from Takealot and reported so you see exactly what changed.

Every figure matches what the TSeller app shows on screen, using the same definitions, so the two never disagree. Nothing is cached — each question fetches fresh data, paced to stay within Takealot's rate limits.

Access is granted per account through a consent screen listing exactly what is requested, and can be revoked at any time in TSeller Settings. Customer names and delivery areas stay hidden unless you approve that separately. An active TSeller subscription is required.

Built for South African Takealot sellers. Amounts are in Rand, dates follow the Africa/Johannesburg calendar.

_published_faq.name: How do I add tseller.co.za to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add tseller.co.za to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tseller.co.za/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the tseller.co.za MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: tseller.co.za lists 28 MCP tools, including bulk_update_offers, get_buybox, get_offer, get_offer_batch, get_offer_charges, get_order, get_product_reviews, get_profitability, get_promotions, get_recon_claims, get_recon_report, and get_replenishment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to tseller.co.za?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to tseller.co.za in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
tseller.co.za requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
tseller.co.za is developed by Block Seven. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
